title: Tuwaiq System Telemetry Provider Input
description: Structured telemetry record consumed by the AI System Intelligence inference pipeline. Mirrors data_collection/collector/schema.py's validate_record() exactly -- keep both in sync (see tests/test_schema_matches_validator.py).

source.description: Provenance of this record. 'future_real' denotes genuinely live telemetry (e.g. tuwaiq-telemetry-provider), as opposed to generated training data.

scenario_label.description: Free-text label. Used by the training pipeline to tag synthetic scenarios (e.g. 'high_cpu_spike'); live producers may use a fixed label such as 'live_snapshot'.

is_synthetic_anomaly.description: True only for deliberately-injected synthetic anomaly records used in training/evaluation. Always false for real captured data.
